subject: sub-04
population: All 120 previously scored participant-photo rows across the same 12 objects. The published native result (8/120 photo and 55/120 full-vocabulary) and earlier neighbor results were known when this protocol was specified. Keep every error. This is a development experiment.
eeg_model: Frozen 884-object global H14 predictor from four measured EEG trials. Its stored training-only rank-32 canonical neighborhood, k=128, mix=0.50, global gain and cap are reused. Predict each row independently. For all four real-EEG conditions use the archived native word, eight selected supports, visual radius, batch order and diffusion seed.

arms.native: Archived conditional EEG vector; must replay all 120 native JPEGs exactly.
arms.matched: Normalized sum with equal weights of the native conditional direction and the entire global EEG estimate for this query. Angle to native support prior may change.
arms.prior: Same native direction, combined with the normalized average of the eight global EEG estimates for the permissible support photos.
arms.wrong: Same native direction, combined with the global estimate from the frozen same-word, same-fold donor. Twelve-class truth is absent from all four generation paths.
arms.reference: SEPARATE evaluation-only intervention: the true original photograph H14 direction at the frozen radius with the original predicted word and seed.
arms.foil: SEPARATE evaluation-only intervention: H14 direction of the other held-out photo of the same true object and fold, using the recipient predicted word and seed.

separation: Freeze the EEG input packet before preparing the reference intervention. Render on separate workers from separate input archives. Only the evaluation-only archive supplies true reference vectors. The reference and foil images can diagnose visual-conditioning capacity and cannot count towards EEG reconstruction.
endpoints: DINOv2-S/14 retrieval of the original among ten same-object photos including all available supports. CLIP-L/14 naming among 1854 and the fixed 12 words. True cosine, full-frame RGB RMSE and luminance correlation, correct-vs-wrong decoded word strata. Compare matched with native, prior and wrong: paired whole-object bootstrap, 10000 draws with the fixed seed. Separately compare true versus foil at the fixed query word and seed. Native naming and within-ten row credits must replay the published baseline. Gallery uses the smallest row number for every object.
advance: Real EEG candidate advances only if lower 95% DINO-ten interval is positive against native and prior, its all-row point difference against wrong is positive, and full-1854 naming credit does not fall versus native. No alternative mixing coefficient or choice from the observed recipients. Diagnostic true-image conditions never enter this decision.
